detail.longDescription: # ElonMusk 's # X Tried to Kill # Nitter . The Project Just Said It’s Coming Back Two weeks after X Corp's legal letter forced the project offline, Nitter says it will continue. Nitter, the # opensource front-end for reading X posts without signing up for an account, is not going anywhere yet. So far, X has not publicly commented on the shutdown or the reversal. https:// itsfoss.com/news/nitter-return s-after-legal-troubles/ # twitter
